title: Bayanat Labs scoping-memo score input (bl-score memo YAML)
description: One candidate's rubric scores, legal tier and effort code, as written in a scoping memo. Scores use the 1/3/5 anchors in policy/rubric.yaml; 2 and 4 sit between anchors.

title.description: Working title, always 'Bayanat Labs ...' for products

legal_tier.description: Legal tier (green, yellow or red) for the planned release; drives the gate together with scores.legal_cleanliness (the more restrictive of the two applies: score 1 excluded, score 2-3 Tier 2 at most)

effort.description: S under one agent-week; M one to four agent-weeks; L one to three agent-months; XL longer or needing a partner

justifications.description: One line per score saying why

seo_demand.description: Optional search-demand score: tie-breaker only, never weighted

source_scores.description: Original scores the memo values were mapped from (e.g. scores on another scale, via a crosswalk)

memo_ref.description: Path or URL of the scoping memo this block belongs to
